titles.title: Foreign Government-Owned Media FARA Registration Act
Foreign Government-Owned Media FARA Registration Act
A bill to amend the Foreign Agents Registration Act of 1938, as amended to clarify that foreign government-owned media operating in the United States must register as a foreign agent.

action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Foreign Relations under authority of the order of the Senate of 09/30/2026.
